promise: By the end, a world that only knew one calm noon has a storm, a night and a first snow, and the tent still stands.

sections.title: Does it hold?
sections.setting: Where day 1 ended: the tent at dusk, the canvas pulling at its pegs
sections.music: The low drone of day 1's end, rising
sections.question: A world that has only ever known one calm noon: what happens when the weather comes?
sections.release: None: the question is left open
sections.gate: Dread to hope, dark to bright: the gust cuts to the trailer's flight and its rising theme

sections.title: The trailer
sections.setting: One drone take over the real city to Samuel with his arms wide, then the game's map turning into the city
sections.music: Its own theme: cinematic, hopeful, friendly; D major, about 105 bpm; one big chord at the end
sections.question: One million humans, a hundred times better way of living: how?
sections.release: First in a game, then for real: the big chord, the lights come on
sections.gate: Flight to crouching, sky to soil: from the widest, fastest pictures to the smallest and slowest, a hand's width of ground

sections.title: The quiet before
sections.setting: Low over the forest floor, eye level with the needles
sections.feeling: Quiet, close, something in the air
sections.music: A single guitar, room tone, birds
sections.question: Why does the ground still look like a print?
sections.release: Needles with depth, moss, a fallen branch: it has things lying on it

beats.note: Cones like loaves, twigs like noodles

sections.gate: Hush to chatter, brown to green, still to moving: from the silent floor up into the bushes, where it gets lively

sections.title: What grows under the pines
sections.setting: Knee-deep in the understory: mastic, rockrose, fern
sections.question: Why is a forest empty under its own trees?
sections.release: Thickets you have to push through, fern where the light falls

beats.note: Bushes like green balls, all alike
They pop in and out as you walk

sections.gate: Play to peril, green to white: the light push through the thicket is torn open by the storm; pizzicato to wind and drums

sections.title: The storm
sections.setting: The open meadow and the tent, in wind, cloud and snow
sections.question: Does the tent, and the world, hold in a storm?
sections.release: The wind drops. Silence. Is the tent still there?

beats.note: The tent takes no snow: wrong

sections.gate: Chaos to stillness, noise to silence: the storm cuts to first light on untouched snow

sections.title: The morning after
sections.setting: First light after the storm: the meadow under snow, the tent standing, clouds drifting off
sections.question: So: what does weather do to a world?
sections.release: It makes it a place: the tent held, snow lies on its roof in clumps, the day turns
sections.gate: Peace to suspense, white to violet: in the untouched snow, a line of footprints that are not yours

sections.title: Footprints
sections.setting: Close on the snow by the tent: a second set of footprints, leading in
sections.question: Who is the second citizen?
sections.release: None: the tent's door moves. Tomorrow.
